title: Guides
description: Task-oriented, step-by-step instructions for common jobs in this portal and in Elektraweb's Angular codebases.

cards.title: How to Add a New Documentation Section
cards.description: Add a whole new top-level section (like Projects or Modules) without writing a new page component.

notes.text: Every section reuses the same two shared components — FeatureIndex for the section's landing page and NodeDetail for every nested card — so a new section is pure configuration, not new UI code.

cards.title: How to Document a Component's Inputs
cards.description: Use the properties field on a node to render an AG Grid-style reference table (name, type, default, description) instead of a plain paragraph.

cards.title: How to Add Callouts and Related Links
cards.description: Use notes for inline Tip / Note / Warning callouts, and related for cross-links to other pages in a page's "Related topics" section.
